messages:
jordan: Hey — our mobile app (org org-1234) suddenly started getting 401 invalid_api_key after SSO refresh. Happened ~2024-11-07T10:12:xxZ. Repro steps below.

jordan: Repro:
1) Login via Okta SSO
2) App receives session, SDK exchanges session for api key
3) Make Text API call -> 401

jordan: Curl we hit locally:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...OLD_TOKEN..." \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"test"}'
```

maria: thanks — can you paste the SDK version + app id and a sample request id from logs?

jordan: app id: mobile-backend-prod, sdk: rdb-mobile@0.9.3, request_id: req_0a1b2c3d
logs:
{"time":"2024-11-07T10:12:03Z","level":"error","msg":"API error","code":401,"error":"invalid_api_key","request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d"}

eng-bot: Automated notice: org org-1234 had keys rotated at 2024-11-07T10:05:00Z by security (rotation-id rot-789). Old customer-managed keys were revoked. :rotating_light:

ryan: looks like mobile clients cached derived api keys in AsyncStorage. When rotation happened, existing tokens started returning 401. SDK should detect 401 and trigger reauth. Can you confirm the SDK is sending Authorization header vs x-api-key?

jordan: it uses Authorization: Bearer header from the exchange. The exchange step returned a key, we store it and send bearer token directly.

sara: Confirmed: security did emergency rotation due to suspected leak. We rotated customer-managed keys for org-1234. Mitigation options:
- Force clients to re-auth (recommended)
- Issue a short-lived fallback token scoped to embeddings only
- Roll back rotation (only if compromised key restored)

maria: For the customer: please clear app storage or upgrade to rdb-mobile@0.9.5 which has automatic reauth-on-401. Quick workaround for CI/dev: delete the cached key and re-login.

alex: any 403s or other errors showing up?

jordan: only 401 invalid_api_key, consistently. No 429/403.

maria: I'll open a support ticket, escalate to the account team, and attach rotation log (rotation-id rot-789). Also sending customer-facing steps and the docs link: https://www.redwood.ai/docs/auth#key-rotation

jordan: thanks all — we'll roll the rdb-mobile upgrade and push an emergency hotfix. Appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
